input.placeholder: Tell the AI what to write…

input.steerHint: AI is generating — what you add applies at its next step

mode.label: Mode
mode.switchedFast: Switched to Fast mode: faster output, less detail.
mode.switchedQuality: Switched to Quality mode: better output quality, longer generation.

input.tooLong: This message has {{count}} characters, over the {{max}} limit. Shorten it, or attach long reference material as a file.

workflow.lowTurnWarning: Close to this round's limit — the AI will finish the most important part first.
workflow.collaborationExhaustedSummary: This is a big task, so the AI paused after many steps. Click "Keep going" to continue.
workflow.toolCallExhaustedSummary: This is a big task, so the AI paused after many steps. Click "Keep going" to continue.

actionPrompt.continue: Please continue from the previous result and finish the remaining work, prioritizing the most critical goal.
actionPrompt.split: Please break the remaining work into 2-3 smaller steps and complete step 1 first.
actionPrompt.manual: Don't change the files yet — tell me what to change and I'll do it myself.

workflow.needsConfirmation: The AI needs your confirmation to continue
workflow.stoppedGeneric: The AI paused. Add details and send again.
workflow.parallelStartTruncated: Working on {{count}} tasks at once ({{dropped}} more were over the per-request limit and did not run this time)

failureHint.notFound: The AI couldn't find that passage and is locating it again.
failureHint.ambiguous: That sentence appears several times; the AI is checking which one.
failureHint.repeatRead: "{{title}}" was already read; continuing with it.
failureHint.repeatReadUntitled: This was already read; continuing with it.
failureHint.authorEdited: "{{title}}" has changes you made yourself, so the AI left it as is. It will ask you before changing it.
failureHint.authorEditedUntitled: This file has changes you made yourself, so the AI left it as is. It will ask you before changing it.
failureHint.clarifyFirst: You haven't said which part to change yet. The AI will ask first; no files were changed.
failureHint.generic: That step didn't work; the AI will try another way.

voice.desktop_stop: Click to stop recording, right-click to cancel
voice.noRecordingData: Nothing was recorded. Please try again.
voice.audioTooLarge: Recording is too long. Shorten it and try again.

voice.recognitionError: Voice recognition failed. Please try again.
voice.browserNotSupported: This browser can't record audio. Try another browser.
voice.micPermissionDenied: Allow microphone access in your browser settings

skill.selectionFull: Up to {{max}} skills per message. Remove one to add another.

feedback.submitFailed: Failed to submit feedback. Please try again later.
feedback.unsupported: Feedback isn't available for this message yet.
